filesChanged: docs/kubernetes.md — the reclaim remedy names the shared directories the layout creates, distinguishes the one small per-role path, says when it is safe to delete them, and scopes the 5.5 GiB reclaim to the intermediate layout.
trickyParts: The defect was found by retro's fresh-eyes subagent at an approved head, verified against manifest.go by me and by the architect, and fixed by a requested backward move to implementing rather than in retro, since only docs/solutions/ and the handoff removal may sit above the approved head without voiding the approval.
discoveredComplexity: A sentence true of the text above it can become false when what it points at changes, without the sentence being edited. Nothing in this paragraph was wrong when written: the remedy described the intermediate per-role layout the paragraph had just measured, and kept pointing at it after the subject became the shipped shared layout. No amount of checking the sentence finds that — only reading the instruction against the system it now describes does, which is what a fresh reader did four corrections in.
